1. About these terms

These Terms of Use apply to OnlyBody, OnlyWeights and onlybody.app, provided by Illia Khvost, Poland. Contact: support@onlybody.app. They describe the conditions for using the website and apps. Please read them before use.

The developer offers these apps as an independent individual and has identified as a non-trader for EU Digital Services Act purposes. That statement does not remove rights or obligations that applicable law makes mandatory.

2. What the apps provide

OnlyBody supports bodyweight workout planning and recording. OnlyWeights supports gym routines, including recorded reps and weights. Both include exercise information, session history, rest timers and optional local reminders. The website introduces these apps and provides support and legal information.

App Store availability and device requirements are shown on the relevant product page. Both apps are currently marked “Coming soon” on this website. No subscription or in-app purchase is implemented in the current apps. Future pricing or paid features, if introduced, will be disclosed before a purchase.

3. Fitness information and your safety

The apps provide general fitness information and recording tools. They are not medical devices, do not diagnose or treat conditions, and do not replace advice from a qualified professional. Generated routines and difficulty labels are general suggestions, not a personalised assessment of your health or ability.

Choose exercises, loads and intensity that suit your abilities and use appropriate equipment and technique. If you are uncertain about suitability, have an injury or health condition, or are returning to training, seek qualified advice before starting. Stop if you experience pain, dizziness or other concerning symptoms. No particular fitness result is guaranteed.

Exercise demonstrations may not suit every person or situation. A minor should have appropriate parent or guardian involvement and comply with applicable age restrictions.

5. YouTube and other external services

The apps use YouTube API Services. By using the apps, you also agree to be bound by the YouTube Terms of Service. Google’s data handling is explained in the Google Privacy Policy and our Privacy Policy.

Videos belong to their respective rights holders and play through YouTube’s official embedded player. The apps do not grant permission to download, extract, modify or redistribute those videos. Embedded content can include advertisements, links and recommendations. Its availability may change or be restricted.

External services have their own terms. The apps are not affiliated with or endorsed by YouTube, Google, Apple or the creators merely because they show their content or use their services.

6. Your records and privacy

Read the Privacy Policy for details of local storage, YouTube, email support and website hosting. Acknowledging a privacy notice does not by itself provide consent for every optional or third-party use of data.

The apps keep their workout records in separate local storage. Removing an app or losing access to the device can cause loss of those records. Review your device’s backup options. The developer does not operate an account-based recovery or cloud-sync service for your workout history.

7. Availability, changes and liability

The apps and website may be updated, interrupted or discontinued. Features, exercise information and external video availability may change. I do not promise uninterrupted access, error-free operation or a particular training outcome. Where required by law, I will provide appropriate notice of material changes.

Responsibility for a problem depends on the facts, the applicable app licence and applicable law. Nothing in these terms excludes or limits liability that cannot lawfully be excluded or limited, including liability for intentional misconduct or any other protected rights. Nothing here makes you waive non-waivable consumer or data-protection rights.

8. Ending use and resolving concerns

You can stop using the apps or website at any time. To remove local app data, use iOS “Delete App”; backups are managed separately. Stopping use does not automatically delete emails you sent or information held by independent third parties.

For questions, complaints or a suspected content issue, write to support@onlybody.app. Please include the app name and enough detail to understand the issue. These terms do not impose mandatory arbitration or prevent you from using a court, regulator or other remedy available under applicable law.
